**Recommended update.** Updating is highly recommended for everyone.

**On your Windows PC:** download **EternalMonitor-Setup.exe** below and run it. It installs over your current version and keeps your settings.

**On your iPad:** open TestFlight and tap **Update** next to EternalMonitor. Update both, so the PC and the iPad app stay on the same version.

You can also download the installer from the [download page](https://eternalmonitor.dev/download.html).

**What's new:** see [RELEASE_NOTES.md](https://github.com/sidebandstudio/EternalMonitor/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md).
